## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      3 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 31, 2026 - Sep 8, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _NazgolH_, Sep 8, 2026, 1/5: "They cancel the subscription, but they still charge your card."
            2. _Seakiing_, Sep 3, 2026, 1/5: "This app is such a scam your subscription doesn’t show up on your iCloud subscriptions and even if you cancel your free trial they still try and charge you 105 dollars completely a scam. Pen and paper is way more affective if you know what your doing in the gym"
            3. _Gekkenhuis13:48.$_, Aug 31, 2026, 1/5: "I signed up for this app and had 7 day free trial and if I cancelled within those days I would not be charged. I cancelled on the 3rd day and they have charged my card. I have sent them an email and no one replied to my email. I dispute the transaction with my bank and the next day they charge it again. Not sure how this happens. Don’t be fooled."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jan 24, 2026 - Sep 4, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _mo4958589594_, Jan 24, 2026, 2/5: "The app has so much potential but is so broken. It alerts me on the wrong days, it does a ludicrous amount of reps and weight for where I’m at in my fitness ability, it will give me 6 exercises for my biceps in one day when my split is meant to be full body every work out. It COULD be great, but it’s not there. I won’t be renewing my subscription"
            2. _NedGames_, Sep 4, 2026, 3/5: "I’ve been using this app for about 2 months and some change now… it’s been great for generating workouts… unfortunately there is 2 glaring issues so far. 1) I spent quite some time letting the app know the equipment I have at home vs the gym… it will still generate workouts correctly but it’s frequently giving me weight targets that don’t exist (what was the point of spending time building my equipment list what if it’s recommending weights that I don’t have) 2) if you add a custom workout in the workouts (something you want to try and end up liking etc) are not added by the AI to the workouts it will generate… you have to do any of your custom workouts manually each time you want to add it in. Pretty frustrating having to figure out the plate issues or bar weight for smith machine vs Olympic in the middle of the workouts while also dealing with it recommending weights that can not be reached with the gear you have. It happens frequently enough that I’m considering looking for an alternative. But this is a good app for generating workouts on a macro level"
<!--/ir-theme-->
